question: Should missing terminal Responses events fail closed for every supported `openai-responses` provider, including custom compatible proxies?
rationale: The strict rule fixes silent empty successes on the reported compatible-provider path, but it can also break existing proxies that currently rely on EOF without emitting the documented terminal event.

options.title: Enforce the Responses contract
options.body: Require terminal events for native, Azure, and custom Responses providers after real interrupted, completed, and incomplete transport proof.

options.title: Scope strictness temporarily
options.body: Limit the guard to proven provider classes and retain custom-proxy compatibility until their terminal-event behavior is separately validated.

recommendation.title: Enforce the Responses contract
recommendation.body: Require terminal events for native, Azure, and custom Responses providers after real interrupted, completed, and incomplete transport proof.
